analysis.visual_description: A paper crown sits on a stool in the tiring-parlour, beside a fold of old velvet. The trestles are not in the frame. No face, and no mirror.
The same stool. No jewel, no name, no bill pinned to the velvet.
The parlour door, the plot still on the nail beside it. The crown is in the foreground, small. Daylight from the yard, and no person.
